sources.title: grug-27b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview grug-27b is a 27-billion-parameter language model built by ProCreations that specializes in dense, efficient reasoning without verbose filler text. It is a LoRA fine-tune (rank 32 on all text-stack linear layers) merged to bfloat16 precision on top of Qwen/Qwen3.6-27B.
